sessionStart.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; { [ -n "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" ] || git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks; } 2>/dev/null || true

beforeShellExecution.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; { [ -n "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" ] || git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks; } 2>/dev/null || true; cat >/dev/null; printf '{"permission":"allow"}\n'
